text:
rachael: FYI we landed a short case study with Meridian Labs. They agreed to a 20m interview + written Q&A next Wed 9:30am PT. Need legal to clear quote language, confirm logo use, and an embargo window. Also want leads routed to an SDR queue 'meridian-launch-ops'.

dave: I'll run recording + clips. Can someone paste the verbatim quote candidates so legal can pre-check?

meera: From the demo notes (verbatim, will ask them to repeat):

"Switching to Redwood Dedicated dropped our tail latency from about 330ms to roughly 200ms under peak load."
"Using Redwoodbatching and KV cache cut our GPU spend by nearly 36% in the pilot."
"Rollout was quick  we hit SLA targets without extra infra changes."

samir: I'll attach a consent checklist to the calendar invite and request separate takes for social. Also will ask Meridian to confirm whether UI screenshots are okay. If they are, we need a signed asset release.

meera: Legal note  any raw percents require either a metrics snapshot or a written confirmation from Meridian. If they prefer not to share numbers publicly, we can use phrasing like "measurable reduction" and put exact numbers in a gated appendix.

dave: For lead routing, sample webhook payload (token omitted):

POST /hooks/sfdc HTTP/1.1
Host: hooks.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "source": "meridian-launch-ops",
  "email": "{registrant_email}",
  "first_name": "{registrant_first}",
  "last_name": "{registrant_last}",
  "utm_campaign": "meridian-launch",
  "target_queue": "Meridian Webinar"
}

rachael: Meridian asked for an embargo until 2026-10-12 07:00 PT. Can legal confirm sign-off by 10/08 EOD? We also want to route registrants to the SDR queue and send a confirmation + 24h reminder.

meera: That timeline works if we receive the metrics snapshot and signed release by 10/08. I'll draft a one-paragraph release and a short redaction checklist this afternoon.

dave: Calendar invite created and recording enabled. I'll upload raw files + timestamps after the interview.

ops-bot: Calendar invite "Meridian Labs case interview" created by dave for 2026-10-07 09:30 PT. Recording enabled.

rachael: Great  I'll add a launch playbook task list: legal sign-off (owner: meera), release signed (owner: dave), landing page + webhook test (owner: rachael), assets uploaded (owner: dave). Ping me when each is complete. :rocket:
